Xanthe Huynh is an American actress for the English-language dub of multiple series, including .

==Biography==
Xanthe was born on June 22, 1987, in Orange, California, USA and became a voice actor as an adult. Xanthe joined the cast during , voicing Lauren. After voicing a character in Pokémon Evolutions, Xanthe gained her most notable role, voicing Liko's classmate Ann during .
